We'll Be Your Safety Net, Should You Need It

Growing a business is—in many ways—like a high-flying circus act. It takes countless hours of hard work, determination, and the recognition that you can’t do it on your own. No matter how good you may be, eventually, something is going to go wrong.

When it does, you can’t afford to look down. You need to know you have an insurance team you can trust. At Stocker Insurance, not only will we be there to catch you, but we’ll propel you back up to the rafters so you can continue growing your business without missing a beat.

Your Business Is Unique—Why Isn’t Your Coverage?

Your business is one-of-a-kind, but so too are your risks. At Stocker Insurance, we make it our goal to identify the unique threats to your business so we can fully protect you from head to toe. This may include any or all of the following:

General Liability Insurance

Commercial Property Insurance

Business Auto Insurance

Worker’s Compensation Insurance

Business Interruption Insurance

Apartments & Condominiums

Restaurants & Hospitality

Start-Ups

Construction

Real Estate

Protection That’s Tailored To Your Industry

Whether you’re a thriving business in a prominent industry or a hungry start-up in an emerging niche market, the insurance experts at Stocker will work with you to get the specialized protection you need.

Your Life Is What You Make It—Let’s Protect That

Your home. Your vehicle. Your worldly possessions. They don’t define you, but they sure help paint a picture. With the right personal insurance policies on your palette, you can ensure your life never goes back to a blank canvas.

At Stocker, we compare the rates of dozens of highly rated insurance carriers so we can find you the coverage you need at the price point you want. In the insurance world, that’s what’s known as a true masterpiece.

More Than Four Walls

A home is more than just four walls and a roof. It’s an office. It’s a playground. It’s a restaurant, hotel, laundromat, auto shop, and movie theater. At Stocker, we insure more than just your home—we protect your way of life.

0–60, Covered

Life can go from 0–60 pretty quickly. One minute you’re learning to parallel park the family van and the next you’re racing your midlife-crisis-mobile around hairpin turns. Whatever (and however) you choose to drive, we’ll make sure it’s covered.

Why Stocker?

We’ve Been Building Trust Since 1986

For over 35 years, Stocker Insurance has been a family business that prides itself on helping other small and mid-sized family businesses. We will work with you one-on-one to learn your business inside and out and take a detailed inventory of your insurance needs. Then—and only then—will we give you our recommendations for moving forward.

At Stocker Insurance, we are tirelessly committed to our clients. In fact, many of our commercial clients have so much faith in us, they trust us to insure what matters most—their families. From home and auto to vacation and recreation, we have the policies and prices you’re looking for to safeguard every aspect of your busy life.

With personal attention and personalized solutions, Stocker Insurance is ready to earn your trust.

About Photo

Founder Photo
(replace with base64 image)
Founder, Insurance Agent

Jim graduated from the University of Minnesota in 2000 with a degree in—of all things—engineering. After spending two years as an engineer at 3M, he made the difficult decision to change career paths and join his family’s insurance business in his hometown of Bloomington. He never looked back.

After 20 years in the insurance world, Jim knew it was time to start his own agency. Having worked at a larger firm, he wanted the opportunity to work directly with his clients and actually have an impact on their lives—something he couldn’t get at a large company.

It was from this core value that Stocker Insurance was born.

Inquiries And Insights

What do you pack for a vacation if you don’t know where you’re going? We design an insurance program for you based on where you want to go with your business. As a client, we consider government regulations, contracts, and leases upfront to make sure you can focus on success. New businesses need to avoid frustration and pitfalls, but we also realize the necessity to put your resources into growth. A cost-effective approach with regular reviews will keep your business vision on track.

As insurance companies work to minimize the huge payouts from storms, we find creative, efficient, and effective solutions so you get the insurance program you want. It may be as simple as just finding the right insurance company for you. In more complicated situations, we might negotiate with companies and acquire a separate policy. You can be sure the separate pieces of your insurance program will create one picture that is both strong and clear.

We serve all areas of the rental property marketplace as a focused specialty. From landlords with a handful of properties to management companies with hundreds of units, we design your program with attentiveness and experience and are committed to service and accessibility.

You should have enough insurance on your building to fully rebuild at today’s costs. There are heavy penalties that reduce your claim payout if you choose not to insure your building to its replacement cost value. We have multiple tools to create a full appraisal and deliver precise coverage. We’ll help you avoid penalties while ensuring you don’t waste valuable resources.

Whether you are a contractor, a business consultant, or a publishing firm, your reputation is your business, and your expertise matters. Let’s say a design company created a brand for a medium-sized technology company, but that brand was not properly vetted through the trademark clearinghouse and the technology company was taken to court. The court costs—along with the judgments and brand damages—would amount to a large claim under the design company’s professional liability policy.

One of our insurance experts would be happy to provide the answers you’re looking for.
